page_title: TOU 2-0 BRE | Toulouse v Brest 24/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+9' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Brest comes to nothing.
90+7' Santiago Hidalgo (Toulouse) goes for goal, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies yards wide of the right post.
90+5' Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) produces a header from inside the penalty area, but he doesn't manage to hit the ball properly and it flies well over the crossbar.
90+5' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Brest.
90+5' Hamidou Makalou (Brest) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
90+4' The corner from Hamidou Makalou (Brest) is hurriedly cleared.
90+2' The resulting corner comes to nothing as Hamidou Makalou (Brest) sends it out of play.
90' The fourth official shows 8 min. of added time.
89' Bradley Locko (Brest) gets a shot away from distance, but wasn't really set to take it and fires high and wide.
88' The corner is swung in but Brest can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
86' Noah Edjouma (Toulouse) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.
84' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Serigne Diop (Brest) comes onto the pitch so that Mama Balde can be given a rest.
83' Here is a change. Dayann Methalie is going off and Carles Martinez gives the last tactical orders to Mathis Saka (Toulouse).
83' Here's the change. Frank Magri leaves the pitch and Santiago Hidalgo (Toulouse) comes on as a substitute.
82' Brest can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
80' Noah Edjouma (Toulouse) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
79' Eric Roy decides to make a substitution. Kamory Doumbia will be replaced by Axel Camblan (Brest).
78' Brest seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
76' The percentage of ball possession is – 49:51.
72' Substitution. Hamidou Makalou (Brest) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Romain Del Castillo walks off.
72' Substitution. Brendan Chardonnet makes his way off the pitch and Michel Diaz Jr. (Brest) comes on as his replacement.
72' Eric Roy has decided to substitute Hugo Magnetti and he is replaced by Joris Chotard (Brest).
71' Carles Martinez has decided to make a change. Noah Edjouma (Toulouse) replaces Yann Gboho.
70' Rasmus Nicolaisen (Toulouse) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Djibril Sidibe.
69' A cross from a corner kick by Brest is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
69' 3:1 – this is the current number of shots on target.
65' 2 - 0 Goal! Frank Magri (Toulouse) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 2:0.
63' Brendan Chardonnet (Brest) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
63' Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) wins the ball near the penalty spot and unleashes a header low towards the middle of the goal, but Guillaume Restes is alert and denies him.
61' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
60' We are about to witness a subsitution. Warren Kamanzi (Toulouse) for Mario Sauer.

55' Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
52' 1 - 0 Goal! Frank Magri (Toulouse) fires the rebound into the bottom left corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:0.
51' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
49' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) commits a rough challenge and Benoit Millot blows his whistle for an infringement.
48' Djibril Sidibe (Toulouse) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
48' Brest are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
46' The whistle blows and Benoit Millot starts the second half.
45+6' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Radoslaw Majecki has no trouble gathering it.
45+2' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) climbs higher than the defenders inside the box and plants a towering header against the crossbar. What a great chance!
45+2' Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) was too forceful with his tackle and Benoit Millot interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
45' 5 additional min. will be played.
45' The free kick from long range, taken by Toulouse, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
44' A player from Brest commits a rough challenge. Benoit Millot blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
43' The ball is cleared after Frank Magri (Toulouse) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
41' Mama Balde (Brest) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
40' Frank Magri (Toulouse) is adjudged offside.
40' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
38' The game is interrupted now, Romain Del Castillo (Brest) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
36' Benoit Millot interrupts the game. One of the players from Brest won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
34' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Toulouse was in an offside position.
32' Djibril Sidibe (Toulouse) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.

30' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Toulouse are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
26' The corner from Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) is cleared away by the defence.
25' Mama Balde (Brest) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
23' It looks like Dayann Methalie (Toulouse) saw red with that tackle. Benoit Millot won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
21' Frank Magri (Toulouse) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
19' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Brest, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
17' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.
16' Mama Balde (Brest) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the roof of the net, but Guillaume Restes thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
16' Mama Balde (Brest) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
15' Mama Balde (Brest) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

14' Frank Magri (Toulouse) wastes a great chance from the resulting corner. He times his header superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross, but can't aim better than into the middle of the goal, straight into the arms of the goalkeeper.
14' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Toulouse.
12' Mama Balde (Brest) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
11' Mama Balde (Brest) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
9' One of the players from Toulouse times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
9' Mama Balde (Brest) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.

8' Brest slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
7' Dayann Methalie (Toulouse) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
6' Djibril Sidibe (Toulouse) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
5' Frank Magri (Toulouse) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
4' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Benoit Millot blows for a foul.
3' Dayann Methalie (Toulouse) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
2' Rough tackle by Frank Magri (Toulouse). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
